test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In the realm of cinema, documentaries are characterised by:

options.text: presenting real-world content for learning or leisure
aiming to communicate about mythological characters

solution:
The Correct answer is __**presenting real-world content for learning or leisure**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Documentaries** are a genre of cinema that focuses on depicting **real-life events, facts, and stories**.
 
• They are used to **educate viewers** or provide **leisure** through the exploration of **real-world topics** such as history, science, politics, culture, and the environment.
 
• Unlike fictional films, documentaries are based on **non-fictional content** and are often supported by interviews, archival footage, and statistical data.
 
• These films aim to enhance the **knowledge** and **awareness** of their audience by presenting **authentic and factual content**.
 
• Examples of popular documentaries include **"An Inconvenient Truth"**, which addresses climate change, and **"The Social Dilemma"**, which explores the effects of social media.
 
• Documentaries can also serve as a platform for **social advocacy**, shedding light on pressing issues and sparking conversations for change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Focusing on fictional suspense**__

 __
 
• This characteristic is typical of **thriller movies**, not documentaries.
 
• Thriller films aim to create tension and excitement through fictional plots, often involving crime, espionage, or other dramatic scenarios.
 
 
 
• **Fabricated storylines**__
 __
 
• Fabricated storylines are a feature of **fictional films**, including dramas, comedies, and science fiction.
 
• Unlike documentaries, these films rely on **imagination and creativity** rather than real-world facts.
 
 
 
• **Aiming to communicate about mythological characters**__
 
 
• Films about mythological characters often belong to the genre of **mythological or historical dramas**.
 
• They may use fictional elements to depict stories from mythology, but they do not fall under the category of documentaries.
